originalTitle: 将 DSA 注意力引入多模态，快手 Keye2.0 开启强化推理新范式
title: Introducing DSA Attention to Multimodal Models: Kuaishou Keye 2.0 Opens a New Paradigm for Enhanced Reasoning
oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou has released the Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B multimodal large language model, which for the first time introduces the DSA sparse attention mechanism to the multimodal domain. It achieves lossless inference with a 256K ultra-long context and unlocks Agent collaboration capabilities, reaching SOTA performance among models of its size on tasks such as long video temporal understanding, code generation, and tool invocation.
summary: This article is an official technical blog post from the Kuaishou AI team, detailing the core technological breakthroughs of their latest multimodal large language model, Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B. It first identifies the pain points of long video understanding: the computational bottleneck and information dilution caused by ultra-long visual contexts. Keye-VL-2.0 addresses this by being the first to apply the DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) architecture in a multimodal setting, combining sparse attention with feature aggregation. This enables deep perception of a 256K ultra-long context, achieving results on video understanding benchmarks like TimeLens and LongVideoBench that surpass closed-source models like Gemini and comparable open-source models. Secondly, the model natively incorporates an Agent collaboration mechanism, demonstrating system-level execution potential in scenarios like Code Agent and Tool Agent. It overcomes catastrophic forgetting in multi-task learning through the innovative MOPD multi-expert policy distillation technique, leading to a comprehensive surge in general capabilities. Finally, the article introduces the Context-RL reward mechanism and a rigorous data engine used in the post-training phase to ensure inference reliability, and discusses the model's potential applications in real-world business scenarios such as Kuaishou's recommendation system and video material production.

mainPoints.point: First to introduce the DSA sparse attention mechanism to the multimodal domain, breaking the bottleneck of long video understanding.
mainPoints.explanation: Keye-VL-2.0 applies DeepSeek Sparse Attention, combining sparse attention with feature aggregation. When processing hour-long videos, it effectively purifies information, enabling lossless inference over a 256K ultra-long context. It surpasses closed-source models like Gemini on benchmarks such as TimeLens.

mainPoints.point: Built-in Agent collaboration mechanism, enabling a full perception-planning-execution pipeline.
mainPoints.explanation: The model natively unlocks Agent capabilities, demonstrating multi-step task decomposition and automated scheduling potential in scenarios like Code Agent (SWE-bench 62.00) and Tool Agent (TAU2-Bench 82.58), moving towards solving real-world complex tasks.

mainPoints.point: Innovative MOPD multi-expert policy distillation technique overcomes catastrophic forgetting.
mainPoints.explanation: Through the cross-modal MOPD technique, it integrates expert models from various vertical domains. It also introduces a novel bucketed advantage scaling method that strengthens core reasoning signals while ensuring multi-task fusion does not compromise the general base model's capabilities, achieving a comprehensive explosion of capabilities across all dimensions.

mainPoints.point: Introduces the Context-RL reward mechanism to build inference reliability.
mainPoints.explanation: The post-training phase employs a Context-RL mechanism, using mixed-modal reference information to construct dense, fine-grained reward signals. This enables factuality supervision at a hyper-geometric distribution level, effectively suppressing hallucinations and ensuring the stability of long-range reasoning.
